career_ladder.note: Junior Assistant (Kanishtha Sahayak) and Junior Clerk form the ministerial backbone of the Uttar Pradesh Civil Secretariat, various departmental directorates, collectorates, and district offices. They handle official file processing, dak correspondence, computerized records, and public grievances, advancing through a structured clerical promotion hierarchy.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to Junior Assistant and Clerk posts comprises preliminary shortlisting based on UPSSSC PET scores, a single-stage Main Written Examination of 100 marks, followed by a mandatory qualifying bilingual computer typing test. Negative marking of 0.25 (1/4th) applies in the written examination.

financial_package.note: Junior Assistant / Junior Clerk is remunerated at Pay Level 3 (Pay Band ₹5,200–₹20,200 with Grade Pay ₹2,000) in accordance with the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules 2016 (7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 3)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 3 entry basic pay of ₹21,700 at 58% DA (effective 01.07.2025), HRA (₹1,800 to ₹3,600 depending on Lucknow secretariat, commissionerate, or district posting), secretariat allowance where applicable, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹3,429) and group insurance deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised twice a year per state government notifications
House Rent Allowance (HRA) based on classification of posting city
Secretariat allowance for staff posted in Uttar Pradesh Civil Secretariat, Lucknow
Medical reimbursement under UP Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual earned leave encashment benefits
